content_text: I personally would advise against physical filters. You cannot undo the effect. Luckily, filter diffusion is the one thing that actually makes sense to do in post imo. There is a plugin that emulates all popular diffusion and haze filters called Scatter from Video Village. It’s visually indistinguishable and you have infinitely more control than with physical filters. I think they have a demo version you can try.
